entities.name: Lhasa–Shigatse Railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Lhasa–Shigatse railway, or Lari railway, is a high-elevation railway that connects Lhasa to Shigatse (Xigazê), in the Tibet Autonomous Region. The travel time between Lhasa and Shigatse on this line is roughly three hours.
